_about: Build layers (after Diablo 4): status tags that spells, passives and powers share; path points that buy spell upgrades (each spell's Enhanced rank and its two forks live on its record in abilities.json); one key passive per character; and legendary powers carried by items. Effects name a kind the engine knows (game/systems/builds.gd lists them).

statuses.name: Burning
statuses.about: Fire or holy damage over time (Flaming Arrow, Light's Burn).

statuses.name: Slowed
statuses.about: Any effect that slows: tar, hexes, Kneeling.

statuses.name: Staggered
statuses.about: A boss whose stagger bar is full.

statuses.name: Fortified
statuses.about: On you: you take less damage.

keyPassives.name: Bloodlust
keyPassives.text: Every hit you land gives a Bloodlust stack: +2% damage, up to 10. The stacks fade 5 seconds after your last hit.

keyPassives.name: Unbroken
keyPassives.text: Resolve you spend heals you twice as much.

keyPassives.name: Assassin
keyPassives.text: Finishers (Double Cut) deal 40% more damage to enemies below 30% health.

keyPassives.name: Venomous
keyPassives.text: All your damage is 15% higher against Poisoned enemies.

keyPassives.name: Trapper
keyPassives.text: Your traps arm at once, and the enemy that springs one is stunned for 2 seconds.

keyPassives.name: Kindling
keyPassives.text: All your damage is 15% higher against Burning enemies.

keyPassives.name: Rotheart
keyPassives.text: While Overcorrupted, your damage over time ticks 30% faster.

keyPassives.name: Soul Tithe
keyPassives.text: Corruption you spend heals you: 0.3% of your health per point, on top of Purge.

keyPassives.name: Zealot
keyPassives.text: Each Holy spell you use gives a Zeal stack: +5% crit chance, up to 5. Your next crit uses them all up.

keyPassives.name: Bulwark
keyPassives.text: While you stand in your own Hallowed Ground you are Fortified: 20% less damage taken.

powers.name: Bloodletter
powers.text: Cleave leaves every enemy it hits Bleeding (Rend).

powers.name: Contagion
powers.text: When an enemy dies, your Rot and Flaming Arrow on it jump to the nearest enemy.

powers.name: Hunter's Patience
powers.text: All your damage is 10% higher against Slowed enemies.
